ci-bot: billing-preview job queued (id=34210) for cohort flex-8pct. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/34210

leo: Preview looks mostly good; one account has a negative delta after pro-rata seat allocation (acct 90021). Adding rule: auto-credit negatives up to $200, flag >$200.

priya: Mapping updated for vendor_gpu_min -> vendor_gpu_min; added validation to compare computed vendor_charge vs recorded, flag >1.2% mismatch. Also added gf_21d tag for enterprise_trial subs.

marta: Legal OK with invoice wording: "You may be eligible for a temporary legacy rate for 21 days". Ops, confirm rollback thresholds: pause if cohort net delta > 10% or error rate > 1%.

ops: Confirmed. Alert will post to #eng-sre and #finance and auto-block cohort routing. Runbook link: https://playbooks/redwood/pricing-flex-rollback

sam_fin: Preflight uploaded: https://files.redwood/preflight/34210/preflight_flex8pct.csv. Summary: avg delta +0.5%, 3 accounts > $600 flagged, 1 negative delta auto-credited $150, vendor mismatch 2 accounts flagged (small rounding)

marta: Final checklist: ratecard sync \u2714, gf_21d tag \u2714, preflight posted \u2714, legal text \u2714. Launch in 30m. If anything trips the alert, we'll rollback to rp_stable.
